metadata.title: Tic Tac Toe
metadata.description: Two alternating marks on a 3×3 board. Three in a row wins; filling the board without a winner draws. Restart clears the game.

participants.name: Local player controlling both alternating marks

variables.name: Board cell: empty, X or O

precondition.expr: state.get('rule:state.winner') == 0 and state.get('rule:state.draw') == False and topology.contains('rule:topology.board', param.coordinate) and grid.get('rule:state.board', param.coordinate) == 0

systems.name: Detect a completed row, column or diagonal
Detect a full board without a winner
Alternate marks unless the game ended

goals.name: Complete three of your marks in a row, column or diagonal

invariants.name: Current mark is X or O
All nine cells have valid values

behavior_tests.name: Occupied cell is rejected and restart clears placements
X wins across the top row; subsequent placement is rejected
Full board without a winning line is a draw

assumptions: One local human participant supplies clicks for both marks, as in the source UI; current_player identifies the alternating mark.
The registered grid.has_line function checks rows, columns and both diagonals of the bounded two-dimensional board.

metadata.title: Tic Tac Toe
metadata.description: Source-drawn board and marks require no image assets. Both status and instruction text use Pygame’s bundled default font at their respective source sizes.

metadata.title: Tic Tac Toe
metadata.description: Source-coloured 3×3 board with blue X marks, amber O marks, and the original status and instruction text.

nodes.name: Turn status while no winner exists

properties.text: Click an empty cell. R: restart. Esc: quit.

bindings.name: Show empty, X or O for each Rule cell
Hide turn status after a win
Hide turn status after a draw
Display X when X is to play
Display O when O is to play

behavior_tests.name: Placed X changes cell appearance and turn status

assumptions: One world unit represents the source's 140-pixel cell pitch. The front-facing view preserves the source's row order and converts HUD positions and font sizes using the 570-pixel viewport height.
Shallow cubes approximate the source's rounded cell rectangles; renderer cross and ring markers approximate its eight-pixel strokes.

metadata.title: Tic Tac Toe
metadata.description: Primary-click an empty board cell to place the current mark; press R to restart. The source also uses Escape to quit, but this input backend has no quit target.

intents.name: Place current mark at selected cell

bindings.name: Primary-click board cell
bindings.accessibility_label: Click a board cell to place the current mark

bindings.name: R to restart
bindings.accessibility_label: Press R to clear the board and restart

unresolved.reason: The source quits on Escape, but this Input IR can target only Rule actions; the Rule catalogue has no quit action and the backend exposes no application-quit input target. Do not bind Escape to restart or another gameplay action.

behavior_tests.name: Primary click places X at the picked board coordinate
Clicking an occupied cell is rejected
R restarts after a completed row

assumptions: The scene's selectable topology-site collider supplies event_data.rule_coordinate for a primary click.
